audit_budget_scopes_timestamp_check.name: audit_budget_scopes_timestamp_check
audit_budget_scopes_timestamp_check.value:
typeof("audit_budget_scopes"."window_started_at") = 'integer'
        and "audit_budget_scopes"."window_started_at" between 0 and 8640000000000000
        and typeof("audit_budget_scopes"."clock_watermark_at") = 'integer'
        and "audit_budget_scopes"."clock_watermark_at" between 0 and 8640000000000000
        and "audit_budget_scopes"."window_started_at" <= "audit_budget_scopes"."clock_watermark_at"
        and ("audit_budget_scopes"."rollback_started_at" is null or (
          typeof("audit_budget_scopes"."rollback_started_at") = 'integer'
          and "audit_budget_scopes"."rollback_started_at" between 0 and 8640000000000000
          and "audit_budget_scopes"."rollback_started_at" <= "audit_budget_scopes"."clock_watermark_at"
        ))

audit_events_request_id_check.name: audit_events_request_id_check
audit_events_request_id_check.value: "audit_events"."request_id" is null or length("audit_events"."request_id") between 1 and 128

audit_events_actor_session_check.name: audit_events_actor_session_check
audit_events_actor_session_check.value:
(
          "audit_events"."actor_session_id" is null
          and "audit_events"."actor_auth_method" is null
        ) or (
          "audit_events"."actor_session_id" is not null
          and "audit_events"."actor_auth_method" is not null
          and "audit_events"."actor_auth_method" in ('oidc', 'jellyfin', 'recovery')
        )

auth_transactions_hashes_check.name: auth_transactions_hashes_check
auth_transactions_hashes_check.value:
length("auth_transactions"."state_hash") = 43
        and "auth_transactions"."state_hash" not glob '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'
        and length("auth_transactions"."browser_binding_hash") = 43
        and "auth_transactions"."browser_binding_hash" not glob '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'

auth_transactions_redirect_uri_check.name: auth_transactions_redirect_uri_check
auth_transactions_redirect_uri_check.value:
length("auth_transactions"."redirect_uri") between 8 and 2048
        and ("auth_transactions"."redirect_uri" like 'https://%' or "auth_transactions"."redirect_uri" like 'http://%')
        and instr("auth_transactions"."redirect_uri", '#') = 0

auth_transactions_return_path_check.name: auth_transactions_return_path_check
auth_transactions_return_path_check.value:
length("auth_transactions"."return_path") between 1 and 2048
        and substr("auth_transactions"."return_path", 1, 1) = '/'
        and substr("auth_transactions"."return_path", 1, 2) <> '//'
        and instr("auth_transactions"."return_path", char(92)) = 0

jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions_time.name: jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions_timestamp_order_check
jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions_time.value:
"jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."created_at" < "jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."expires_at"
        and "jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."next_poll_at" >= "jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."created_at"
        and "jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."next_poll_at" <= "jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."expires_at"
        and ("jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."consumed_at" is null or (
          "jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."consumed_at" >= "jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."created_at"
          and "jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."consumed_at" <= "jellyfin_quick_connect_transactions"."expires_at"
        ))

oidc_providers_client_secret_check.name: oidc_providers_client_secret_check
oidc_providers_client_secret_check.value:
(
          "oidc_providers"."token_endpoint_auth_method" = 'none'
          and "oidc_providers"."encrypted_client_secret" is null
        ) or (
          "oidc_providers"."token_endpoint_auth_method" in ('client_secret_basic', 'client_secret_post')
          and "oidc_providers"."encrypted_client_secret" is not null
          and length("oidc_providers"."encrypted_client_secret") between 1 and 8192
        )

oidc_providers_approved_endpoint_origins.name: oidc_providers_approved_endpoint_origins_json_check
oidc_providers_approved_endpoint_origins.value:
length("oidc_providers"."approved_endpoint_origins_json") between 2 and 4096
        and json_valid("oidc_providers"."approved_endpoint_origins_json")
        and json_type("oidc_providers"."approved_endpoint_origins_json") = 'array'
        and json_array_length("oidc_providers"."approved_endpoint_origins_json") between 0 and 16

oidc_providers_discovery_attribution_che.name: oidc_providers_discovery_attribution_check
oidc_providers_discovery_attribution_che.value:
(
          "oidc_providers"."discovery_state" = 'unchecked'
          and "oidc_providers"."discovery_checked_at" is null
          and json("oidc_providers"."discovery_capabilities_json") = '{}'
        ) or (
          "oidc_providers"."discovery_state" = 'failed'
          and "oidc_providers"."discovery_checked_at" is not null
        ) or (
          "oidc_providers"."discovery_state" = 'ready'
          and "oidc_providers"."discovery_checked_at" is not null
          and json("oidc_providers"."discovery_capabilities_json") <> '{}'
          and json_array_length("oidc_providers"."approved_endpoint_origins_json") between 1 and 16
        )

service_identity_links_health_attributio.name: service_identity_links_health_attribution_check
service_identity_links_health_attributio.value:
(
          "service_identity_links"."health_state" in ('linked', 'unavailable')
          and "service_identity_links"."connector_id" is not null
          and "service_identity_links"."encrypted_access_token" is not null
          and "service_identity_links"."token_created_at" is not null
          and "service_identity_links"."revoked_at" is null
        ) or (
          "service_identity_links"."health_state" = 'relink_required'
          and "service_identity_links"."encrypted_access_token" is null
          and "service_identity_links"."token_created_at" is null
          and "service_identity_links"."revoked_at" is null
        ) or (
          "service_identity_links"."health_state" = 'revoked'
          and "service_identity_links"."encrypted_access_token" is null
          and "service_identity_links"."revoked_at" is not null
        )

sessions_auth_attribution_check.name: sessions_auth_attribution_check
sessions_auth_attribution_check.value:
(
        "sessions"."auth_method" = 'oidc'
        and "sessions"."user_id" is not null
        and "sessions"."oidc_provider_id" is not null
        and "sessions"."external_identity_id" is not null
      ) or (
        "sessions"."auth_method" = 'jellyfin'
        and "sessions"."user_id" is not null
        and "sessions"."oidc_provider_id" is null
        and "sessions"."external_identity_id" is null
        and "sessions"."service_identity_link_id" is not null
        and "sessions"."oidc_session_id_hash" is null
        and "sessions"."encrypted_id_token_hint" is null
      ) or (
        "sessions"."auth_method" = 'recovery'
        and "sessions"."user_id" is null
        and "sessions"."oidc_provider_id" is null
        and "sessions"."external_identity_id" is null
        and "sessions"."service_identity_link_id" is null
        and "sessions"."oidc_session_id_hash" is null
        and "sessions"."encrypted_id_token_hint" is null
      )

sessions_csrf_hash_check.name: sessions_csrf_hash_check
sessions_csrf_hash_check.value:
length("sessions"."csrf_token_hash") = 43
        and "sessions"."csrf_token_hash" not glob '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'
        and length("sessions"."encrypted_csrf_token") between 1 and 8192

sessions_privacy_hashes_check.name: sessions_privacy_hashes_check

sessions_timestamp_order_check.name: sessions_timestamp_order_check
sessions_timestamp_order_check.value:
"sessions"."created_at" <= "sessions"."last_rotated_at"
        and "sessions"."last_rotated_at" <= "sessions"."last_seen_at"
        and "sessions"."last_seen_at" <= "sessions"."expires_at"
        and "sessions"."expires_at" <= "sessions"."absolute_expires_at"
        and ("sessions"."revoked_at" is null or "sessions"."revoked_at" >= "sessions"."created_at")
